pages.text: Works as a room or as open ground. At least 27 blocks of space.$(p)Grants:$(li)Call of the Herd, growing with the tier, up to +3.$(p)Tiers begin at a score of 4.

Will not count without:$(li)4 of Hay Bale$(p)Rewards, most first:$(li)Water Cauldron$(li)any fence gates$(li)Hay Bale$(li)Cauldron$(li)any fences$(p)Counts against it:$(li)any crops$(li)$(l:soulhome:multiblocks/tags#bookshelves)any bookshelves$(/l)$(li)$(l:soulhome:multiblocks/tags#smithing)any smithing$(/l)
pages.title: What counts

pages.text: None of this is required, but building it well earns more than the blocks alone:$(li)Stall encloses the room, and gate runs along stall, and feed is inside stall, or trough is inside stall.
pages.title: How you arrange it

pages.text: What those parts are:$(li)Stall: any fences$(li)Gate: any fence gates$(li)Feed: Hay Bale$(li)Trough: Cauldron or Water Cauldron
